receipts.open_definition: receipts in status IMPORTED (not yet received/closed)

capture.method: Live WISE API pull on tenant LT, facility LT_F1, item-time-zone America/Los_Angeles. Active = statuses NEW + IN_PROGRESS. KPI totals are the API's own server-reported totalCount for each filtered query; top-N and order-plan breakdowns are computed over every record of the filtered population (paginated, retried, de-duplicated by task/order id).
capture.plan_notes: active_order_plans groups the live active pick tasks by orderPlanId; status is MIXED when a plan's tasks span more than one status, and assignee is the plan's majority assignee.
capture.bay4_note: Bay 4 = DOCK50-DOCK72 (23 doors). spaceStatus is read from the live WMS location master for each door; activeLoadTasks / activeReceiveTasks count active (NEW + IN_PROGRESS) load and receive tasks reporting that dockName, and occupiedCustomerIds are those tasks' customers (falling back to the location master's occupiedCustomerIds when no active task is on the door).
